home.intro: The Oasis is planned as a persistent community hub: start in a central Hub, discover worlds others have made, personalize an avatar and Home, or create worlds of your own. Visitors won't need to code.
home.now: The public foundation is verified. A separate private LAN visitor pilot is implemented; no public application service is available.

pillars.title: Arrive together
pillars.detail: A new account will create or select an avatar and start in the central Hub, with a launch dashboard available to find a next step.

pillars.title: Make it yours
pillars.detail: A player will control their avatar and outfit, open a personal Home, and carry their choices between compatible worlds.

pillars.title: Explore and create
pillars.detail: Find worlds made by the community or build one with code. Visitors can explore without programming; creator tools are one path inside the larger Oasis.

project.next: F1 is verified. LV1 implements a private desktop-browser visitor slice with a shared Hub, two original worlds, player-owned colors, portal travel and confirmed saves. Physical LAN and 24-hour checks remain separate gates. S1 creator tools and S2 accounts remain planned.

progress.intro: The public foundation is verified. A private LAN visitor pilot is implemented, with its actual checks and remaining gates recorded separately. No public application service is available.

roadmap.intro: The Oasis has a broad journey: establish its foundation, prove a small LAN visitor loop, complete creator tools, then earn each public online capability with its own evidence. No dates or percentages are promised.

community.intro: The Oasis is being shaped in public, one careful step at a time. Help review research, accessibility, architecture, documentation and the bounded private visitor pilot.
